shared_inputs.patch_tokens: 49 frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 projected and L2-normalized patch tokens, each dimension 512
shared_inputs.patch_coordinates: fixed row-major 7x7 cell-center coordinates in [-1,1], dimension 2
shared_inputs.standardization: patch-token and language mean/std fit on demo31--33 only; fixed coordinates are not standardized

probe.loss: binary cross entropy with frozen T1 soft target 0/0.5/1

R1.name: task-independent spatial patch content pooling
R1.patch_projection: shared Linear(514,32) key and shared Linear(514,32) value over [patch,coordinate]
R1.selector: one learned 32-D query independent of task language
R1.state_representation: [attention-weighted value, unweighted mean value, attention center, normalized attention entropy] [67]

R2.name: language-conditioned single-slot patch pooling
R2.patch_projection: shared Linear(514,32) key and shared Linear(514,32) value over [patch,coordinate]
R2.state_representation: [attention-weighted value, unweighted mean value, attention center, normalized attention entropy] [67]

R3.name: language-conditioned relational dual-slot patch pooling
R3.patch_projection: shared Linear(514,32) key and shared Linear(514,32) value over [patch,coordinate]
R3.selector: Linear(512,64) split into two independent 32-D task-language queries
R3.interpretation_boundary: the two slots are task-conditioned visual relation slots; neither is called an object, bowl, plate, or localization result

attention.equation: softmax(q dot k / sqrt(32)) over exactly 49 patches
